title: Croatian Red Pilaf with Crumbly Potatoes
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish from Croatia, served with crumbly potatoes on top. This recipe is perfect for a comforting lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the cooked pilaf to the pan and stir to combine with the bell pepper.
Add the diced potatoes to the pan and stir to combine with the pilaf and bell pepper.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cook for a further 5-7 minutes until the potatoes are golden brown and the pilaf is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
